name: Khi biển cả cất tiếng ca
source:
"Can you hear it? That music? The magnificent symphony of the ocean!"

The indie game project "When the sea lifts its voice" is a musical visual novel centered around the Bả Trạo fishing songs of the fishermen in Central Vietnam.

Follow Thương, a journalist returning to her homeland after years away to research the Cầu Ngư (Fish Praying) ritual. Together, we will listen to the sea's melodious rhythms and seek the legends born from the sound of crashing waves.
translation:
“你听到了吗？那音乐？海洋的壮丽交响曲！”

独立游戏项目《当大海扬起声音》是一部以越南中部渔民的Bả Trạo渔歌为中心的音乐视觉小说。

跟随Thương的脚步，一名记者离开多年后回到祖国，研究Cầu Ngư（鱼祈祷）仪式。我们将一起聆听大海悠扬的韵律，寻找海浪拍打声中诞生的传奇。
